role: Specification for coordinator curation, NOT an extractor and NOT an observed report

shared/setup-identities.json.types: hashes=64 lowercase hex; sources=40 lowercase hex; data_layout/nonempty paths=str; byte counts=int>=0; no null after successful setup
shared/setup-identities.json.binaries: for each required tool: path, SHA256, bytes, source/build origin; verify before/after each case
shared/setup-identities.json.availability: missing immutable pin or unfilled binary/layout pin => SETUP_FAIL before any compiler invocation

CASE/manifest.json.phases: setup/build/compiler/linker/driver/curation separate status, exit, signal, timed_out; compiler child PID and actual argv/wait receipt; NOT_RUN requires exit=null, not invented0

CASE/roots.json.mode: Harnesses; units=1, cache=0 process-qualified; one row for exact case, no stubs/test/automatic roots; linked GOTO may be NOT_RUN on compiler/linker failure

CASE/compiler-process.json.state: NOT_RUN | COMPLETE | TIMEOUT | INTERRUPTED | UNKNOWN; preserve actual wait status; codegen_completed alone is insufficient

CASE/driver-process.json.linker_executions: each goto-cc path/SHA/argv/exit/signal separately; no solver/inventory probe
CASE/driver-process.json.solver_executions: must equal []; missing execution coverage is UNKNOWN/STOP, not zero by assumption

CASE/compiler/PID-coverage.json.counts: emitted/dropped/filtered maps str->int>=0; bytes/attempted int>=0; filter and limits; reconcile all files/PIDs; preserve CI_MUST_VALIDATE until independently checked; no rewritten observer claims

CASE/compiler/PID-SEQUENCE-STAGE.json.payload: exact compiler-produced string, not command text; JSON MIR snapshots use matching compiler serde crate
CASE/compiler/PID-SEQUENCE-STAGE.json.runtime_binding: NOT_RUN; never upgrade it after compile success
CASE/compiler/PID-SEQUENCE-STAGE.json.integrity: per-file SHA256+bytes in artifact index; FNV fingerprint is structural only, not integrity
CASE/compiler/PID-SEQUENCE-STAGE.json.instance_data: compiler-serde encoded Instance(kind/def indices), or null for unscoped records; tie helper/root kind and def identity without Debug/body queries

field_contract.identities: full source/tree/diagnostic/base, input+config SHA, setup SHA, case/PID/unit/cache/root, target/sysroot/layout/binary identities and source-stage-target match

compilation.exit_rule: int or explicit null with phase status/reason; preserve independent original nonzero exits, never normalize to0

lowering_suitability.rule: independent of compiler success; IMMUTABLE_ALLOCATION_BOUND is compiler observation only, no verification PASS

coverage.required_fields: map of every requirement to PRESENT/ABSENT_WITH_COMPLETE_BINDING/NOT_ACTIVATED/NOT_APPLICABLE/UNKNOWN, reason and anchors; missing/null/wrong-type/partial/wrong-stage/identity fields are not complete
coverage.complete_rule: all required joins positively bound; dropped={} (or all0); hashes and file counts reconciled; solver_exec_count=0 with execution receipt; no unknown required fields
coverage.scope_rule: filtered stages intentionally outside root/compare/operand scope remain listed; required filtered fields cannot be relabeled N/A

snapshots.instances: exact root plus compare for helper; direct helper field explicitly NOT_APPLICABLE
snapshots.snapshot: record ID, SHA256, compiler phase/root/Instance, JSON pointer to body; original emitted MIR file/range/hash if available; absent original emitted MIR is explicit UNKNOWN, no substituted source text

raw_eq.required_specialization: [MaybeUninit<u8>;3], actual type/layout binding; no inferred SpecArrayEq<u8,4> or synthetic retained call

caller_helper.helper_mapping: actual argument0->left formal and argument1->right formal, MIR types/projections/offsets/GOTO symbols; inlining if present explicit with complete join or UNKNOWN
caller_helper.direct_case: state=NOT_APPLICABLE; preserve reason, other fields null

operands.original_bytes: array of byte integer0..255 for Some(value), null for None; Some masks bool array; immutable expected masks are hypotheses until measured
operands.relocations: array (possibly empty after full allocation provenance coverage) of offset, width, end_exclusive, target compiler AllocId/kind; width from actual target layout, not host guess
operands.stack_or_aggregate: allocation=null only with complete actual stack/aggregate mapping and reason; no immutable mask synthesized from source or GOTO initializer
operands.reuse: actual requested symbol, existing alloc_map match, resulting symbol; both operand joins retained even for shared symbol/AllocId
operands.runtime_objects: no runtime object ID field; compiler opaque IDs are process-local

full_byte_checks.expected: both actual CheckAs full-byte type[u8;3]/size3/mask[true,true,true]; expression/CFG pairing, no suffix-number or source-label assumptions
full_byte_checks.unsupported_or_absent: explicit status/reason+complete positive site binding; otherwise incomplete. No runtime/reached status filled

delayed_activation.status: targets_count=0 -> EMPTY/NOT_ACTIVATED; >0 -> ACTIVATED; absent event -> UNKNOWN
delayed_activation.empty: graph_status and instrumentation_phase_status=NOT_ACTIVATED for this invocation only; no claim of absence of all writes/setters
delayed_activation.nonempty: graph_status=FILTERED_OUT_OF_SCOPE; no graph/callee bodies requested; compiler body checks separately bound

field_contract.artifacts: array of path, bytes, SHA256, case/PID/stage/root, retained ranges and required-field coverage; include exact/complete flags for fragments; no full/raw log/archive handoff

anchors.coordinate: JSON pointer for structured payload; otherwise explicit byte range or line+column with encoding; path/name alone does not prove operand or causal binding
anchors.integrity: verify each exact file/SHA/config/source/target/phase before joining; process-qualified IDs only

STOP_AFFECTED_CASE: solver execution or missing execution receipt
required operand/helper/check binding filtered or incomplete
failure_policy.preservation: persist original exits/errors and bounded incomplete report; unknown fields stay UNKNOWN/null with reason; later stages explicitly NOT_RUN on setup fail; no retry
failure_policy.prelaunch_cap_failure: STOP before launch; concrete narrower filter/package revision required, no cap growth

reporting: No CI PASS, runtime witness, measured negative, release acceptance, B1/B2 or independent proof credit from compile-only reports.
